_comment: Least-privilege AWS IAM policies for the SQS broker roles, for production deployment. NOT locally verifiable: LocalStack Community does not evaluate IAM (ENFORCE_IAM is a Pro feature, verified empirically on 4.14.0 — unsigned and forged-signature requests are answered 200). Verify in AWS with `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` or in LocalStack Pro. ARNs use the challenge account/region placeholders (000000000000/us-east-1); substitute the real account. The application authenticates to the broker with the AWS credential chain (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, IRSA or instance role); see internal/adapters/sqs/sqs.go.

jungle-wager-producer.comment: External game providers (or their ingress service) may ONLY send to the intake FIFO. They cannot receive, delete or administer queues.

jungle-wager-consumer.comment: The application replicas consuming the intake FIFO and dead-lettering permanently invalid envelopes.

jungle-event-publisher.comment: The outbox publisher may ONLY publish integration events; it cannot consume or mutate any queue.

jungle-queue-admin.comment: Provisioning/operations role (CI or platform operator), separate from every runtime role.

queueResourcePolicy.comment: Resource policy attached to each queue: only the account's designated roles may act; every other principal is denied. This is the broker-side authorization layer that the HMAC message signature complements (different layers: broker access vs financial payload authenticity).
